nobodyAlone.en: Nobody sits alone. Every table needs at least two friends.

tableSize.en: Keep tables cosy: {min} to {max} friends at each one.

tableSizeMax.en: No more than {max} at a table, so everyone can join the chat.

withFriendly.en: {a} would love a friendly face 😊 at the table.

sameTable.en: {a} and {b} are working together. Seat them at the same table.

shareInterest.en: {a} and {b} both love {icon} {trait}. Seat them together!

apart.en: {a} and {b} had a hard morning, so let's give them space today. {adult} is helping them talk it out.

besides.en: {a} and {b} are seat buddies. Seat them side by side.

accessibleSeat.en: {a} uses a wheelchair ♿. Pick a seat at the end of a row, where there is room.

fairTeams.en: Make the teams fair! The ⭐ totals can differ by at most {tol}, so the game is fun for everyone.
